Official Title: An Open-Label, Multicenter, Randomized Phase 3 Study of First-Line Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab With or Without Chemotherapy Versus Standard of Care Therapy... in Participants With Metastatic BRAF V600E-Mutant Colorectal Cancer
Intervention (Primary Agents): Drug: Encorafenib, Drug: Cetuximab, Drug: Chemotherapy (mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI)
Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC); Locally confirmed BRAF V600E-mutant; Previously untreated (0 prior regimens) in the metastatic setting (Safety Lead-in allows 0-1); ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease.
Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Locally confirmed or unknown MSI-H or dMMR (unless ineligible for ICIs); Symptomatic brain metastases; Active bacterial or viral infections within 2 weeks prior to dosing.

Official Title: A Single-Arm, Phase II Study of Autophagy Modulation Using Hydroxychloroquine in Combination With Encorafenib and Cetuximab or Panitumumab in Metastatic BRAF-mutated Colorectal Cancer Refractory to Standard Therapies
Intervention (Primary Agents): Drug: Hydroxychloroquine, Drug: Encorafenib, Drug: Cetuximab or Panitumumab
Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Metastatic BRAF V600E-mutated Colorectal Cancer; Progression on at least 1 prior line of therapy (refractory); ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ and bone marrow function.
Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy ≤14 days prior to study start; Symptomatic or untreated/unstable leptomeningeal disease or spinal cord compression; History of acute MI or coronary syndromes within 6 months; Current risk factors for Retinal Vein Occlusion (RVO) or severe eye disease.

Official Title: SX-682 and Nivolumab for the Treatment of RAS-Mutated, MSS Unresectable or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer, the STOPTRAFFIC-1 Trial
Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum that is metastatic or unresectable; Tumor is RAS-mutated (KRAS or NRAS) and microsatellite stable (MSS) / proficient in mismatch repair (pMMR); Received at least two prior regimens of therapy for unresectable or metastatic CRC; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease (RECIST v1.1).
Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Major surgery within 4 weeks; Prior treatment with an IDO inhibitor or PD-1/PD-L1/CTLA-4 inhibitor; Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases, or those requiring corticosteroids.

Official Title: Study of RMC-6236 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors Harboring Specific Mutations in RAS
Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed advanced solid tumor (including Colorectal Cancer) with specific KRAS G12 mutations (dose escalation) or RAS mutations (dose optimization/expansion); Received prior standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage; ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ function.
Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Active or untreated brain metastases that are symptomatic or require corticosteroids; History of non-infectious pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease (ILD); Prior treatment with a RAS-MULTI(ON) inhibitor (e.g., RMC-6236).

Official Title: NEO: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy, Excision and Observation for Early Rectal Cancer (The NEO Trial)
Intervention (Primary Agents): Drug: Chemotherapy (FOLFOX or CAPOX), Procedure: Transanal Excision Surgery (TES), Other: Observation
Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed invasive well-moderately differentiated rectal adenocarcinoma; Tumor stage cT1-T3abN0 (early-stage) based on pelvic MRI; M0 stage (no evidence of metastatic disease); Mid- to low-lying tumor eligible for local tumor excision; ECOG PS 0-1.
Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: History of other malignancy (unless adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer or curatively treated in-situ cancer ≥5 years ago); Synchronous cancer; Prior treatment for rectal cancer; Previous pelvic radiation for any reason.
